title: Proposal - Healthcare AI Assistant RFP

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content: This proposal outlines a phased AI implementation with citation-grounded delivery and governance controls.

citations.section: The solution must leverage Generative AI and machine learning to:

sections.title: Understanding of Problem
sections.content: Client requires a secure, scalable AI platform with strict compliance and measurable business outcomes.

citations.section: The solution must leverage Generative AI and machine learning to:

sections.title: Proposed Solution + Architecture
sections.content: Primary approach: Plan A - RAG First with fallback option Plan B - Domain Fine-Tune Hybrid.

sections.title: Implementation Plan
sections.content: Phase 1 Discovery (2-4 weeks), Phase 2 Build (6-10 weeks), Phase 3 Scale/Operate (ongoing).

sections.title: Team and Delivery Model
sections.content: Hybrid onshore/offshore team with PM, AI architect, ML engineers, data engineers, and QA.

sections.title: Pricing Assumptions and SOW Boundaries
sections.content: Expected monthly run-rate: USD 2,816.00. Scope excludes source-system replatforming unless specified.

citations.section: Proposals will be evaluated based on:

sections.title: Risks and Mitigations
sections.content: Key risks include privacy, hallucination, and regulatory controls; mitigations include HITL and guardrails.

sections.title: Differentiators
sections.content: Reusable accelerators, citation traceability, and measurable evaluation framework.
